root_cause.text: The tp_meter implementation did not check whether the mesh is still in the ACTIVE state before starting or processing new throughput measurement sessions, allowing new sessions to be initiated during teardown when the mesh state is no longer valid.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds atomic_read(&bat_priv->mesh_state) != BATADV_MESH_ACTIVE checks in batadv_tp_start, batadv_tp_init_recv, and batadv_tp_meter_recv, preventing new sessions from being created or handled after the mesh has left BATADV_MESH_ACTIVE. The commit message explicitly states the fix prevents starting new sessions during teardown.

    throughtput measurements tool like iperf and netperf. It is intended to
    approximate TCP behaviour.
    
    It is invoked through batctl: the protocol is connection oriented, with
    cumulative acknowledgment and a dynamic-size
